No backfill of 3316 legacy rows. NEXT: architect.
decision_journal.what_considered: (A) Wire conviction from assembleBriefing.topConviction — REJECTED (assembleBriefing does NOT post agent_signals rows; topConviction is a response struct field). (B) Severity-map fallback only — REJECTED (ignores real alert.confidence_score already in Alert object). (C) Wire alert.confidence_score with severity-map fallback + remove DEFAULT — CHOSEN (real value first, deterministic proxy only when absent, DEFAULT removal makes omission honest).
decision_journal.why_change: Three-path root cause: the column DEFAULT is the structural enabler; removing it + wiring real values + hardening read-path is the minimal correct fix set.
